attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Removing the 'type=module' attribute from theme/admin scripts and theme-manager.js changes script execution semantics (module scope, deferred execution, strict mode) which could break behavior relying on module loading order or scoping if those files use ES module syntax (import/export)."}
